name: The Burren & Cliffs of Moher
summary: A grey limestone moonscape sliding into Galway Bay, ringed by villages the tour buses pass through without stopping. The Cliffs of Moher earn the fuss — but the coast road around Black Head, with nobody on it, is the part I'd go back for.
highlights: The coast road from Ballyvaughan around Black Head
Cliffs of Moher in October — wind, spray, and room to stand
Kinvara's harbour and a late lunch in Doolin
